# Appendices {.unnumbered}

The following appendices to this book provide quick-reference guides and checklists that you can use while working through the book and when carrying out your own crime-mapping projects.

[Functions for reading data into R](read_functions.qmd)
: Find the appropriate R function for loading common types of tabular and spatial data, together with the package that provides it and whether it can read compressed or remote files.

[Checklist: Making a good crime map](map_checklist.qmd)
: Use this checklist to review whether a crime map communicates clearly, includes the necessary context and supporting information, and is appropriate for its intended audience and purpose.

[Common R errors and how to fix them](common_errors.qmd)
: Look up common R error messages, understand what they usually mean and find practical steps for fixing the underlying problem.

[Some R functions you should avoid](functions_to_avoid.qmd)
: Learn which older or potentially problematic R functions to avoid, why they can cause difficulties and which modern alternatives to use instead.

[Checklist: handling code errors](handling_errors.qmd)
: Follow a step-by-step process for identifying the source of an error, checking common causes and creating a reproducible example when you need further help.
